description: This file defines an abstract class StyleBase within the PhpSpreadsheet library used for reading style data from XML. It contains utility methods for identifying fixed style values and retrieving XML node attributes.

classes.name: StyleBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing utility functions for handling style XML data during spreadsheet parsing.

methods.name: identifyFixedStyleValue
methods.description: Checks if a style attribute value matches any value in a provided style list, case-insensitive, and updates the attribute accordingly.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for a given XML node; returns an empty XML element if input is null.
